So Origin Kata Phuket

Condominium in Kata
HomeSaleSo Origin Kata Phuket

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the completed project.

Project overview

So Origin Kata is a low-rise condominium by Origin Property in Kata, Phuket. Per the developer's page it has four low-rise buildings of eight storeys on about 5 rai, with 686 units. Units range from compact one-bedroom layouts to two-bedroom layouts, furnished with balconies. Shared facilities include pools, an inner courtyard, fitness and co-working areas.

So Origin Kata Phuket: key facts

  • So Origin Kata Phuket is a low-rise condominium in Kata, Phuket, developed by Origin Property PCL.
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 26–65 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Sep 2027.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿3,255,000.
  • Nearest beach: Kata Beach (short walk (about 800 m per one portal), walking).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Kata Beach (short walk (about 800 m per one portal), walking); Chalong Hospital (4.6 km, straight line); Patong Hospital (7.9 km, straight line); Makro (400 m, straight line).
  • More projects by Origin Property in our catalogue: Origin Residences Phuket Bangtao, The Origin Kathu-Patong.
